audit_inventory.name: tools_decode_transaction
audit_inventory.purpose: Raw signed tx -> structured fields (BTC + EVM)
audit_inventory.evidence: live 500 internal_error on a real 110-byte legacy ETH tx (chain=ethereum, eth, evm and auto all 500); a truncated payload correctly returns 400, proving the decode path runs. BTC branch returns 200. Root cause: decode_transaction returns v/r/s as bytes; the working tree adds a hex conversion that is NOT in git HEAD and therefore NOT deployed. Reproduced locally: reverting that one hunk yields exactly HTTP 500.

audit_inventory.name: tools_crypto_calculator
audit_inventory.evidence: Hex key -> live 500 internal_error ('coincurve'/'pycryptodome' present but 'base58' path: a hex key reaches _btc_addresses which needs base58; base58 IS declared, so the 500 is a separate undiagnosed crash - needs server logs). WIF key -> live 400 'unrecognised WIF payload length 33/34'. Root cause of the 400: crypto_calculator's WIF dispatch strips the 0x80 version byte only for the compressed form and matches payload length instead, so an uncompressed WIF (33B) is misread as compressed and a real compressed WIF (34B) is rejected. Fixed in the working tree; fix is NOT deployed.
